decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket counter while preserving the Small Block counter.
The existing same-message MODIFY records the $5-per-mint allocation to the remaining Small Block pool; the other Small Block rules remain valid.
The existing same-message MODIFY removes the Big Block prize copy and revises affected FAQ statements to describe only Small Block tickets, prizes, funding, and delivery.
The existing same-message MODIFY replaces the two-draw allocation with Small Block allocation only.
The existing same-message MODIFY narrows winner selection and scope to the remaining Small Block draw while preserving the still-valid VRF method.
The source explicitly preserves the affiliate share at $5, so the referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, and payout behavior remain unchanged.
The existing same-message MODIFY replaces the process copy with Small Block-only ticket and prize descriptions; no other About-page attribute necessarily changes.
The existing same-message MODIFY removes the obsolete Big Block ticket-counter visibility attribute while retaining the valid Small Block counter and badges.
Removing Big Block prizes does not change the established automatic direct-wallet delivery behavior for the remaining Small Block prizes.
The Winners page, dashboard, and email notification channels remain applicable to winners of the remaining Small Block prizes.
The hero's generic reference to prize-draw tickets remains accurate for repeated Small Block ticket issuance and does not explicitly retain a Big Block claim.
The source changes the $15 primary-mint allocation and removes Big Blocks but does not change the flat $10 secondary-sale royalty.
